facts.fact: Justice minister Kassogué says the national judicial case-management software was developed at the state Agence des technologies de l'information et de la communication (Agetic) for the justice ministry.
facts.system: Logiciel de gestion des dossiers judiciaires

facts.fact: The article reports the launch of the Agetic-developed national case-management software for courts at the 3rd Semaine de la justice, with UEMOA funding under PRDEN pilot projects and no contractor named.
